- `markdown +create` 的目标参数不要猜:Drive 文件夹用 `--folder-token`,Wiki 节点用 `--wiki-token`。如果用户给的是 URL,可以直接传完
- `--name` 和本地 `--file` 文件名都必须显式带 `.md` 后缀;不满足时 shortcut 会直接报错

- `@file` 从本地文件读取内容

- `markdown +patch` 当前只支持**单组** `--pattern` / `--content`

content.value_statement: Lark Markdown files can be hard to manage through raw Drive tokens and CLI flags. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through safe create, fetch, patch, overwrite, and diff workflows.
actual_capabilities: Creates native Markdown files in Lark or Feishu Drive folders.
Creates Markdown files under supported Wiki nodes.
Fetches remote Markdown content or saves it to a local file.
Overwrites existing Drive Markdown files with new content or local files.
Applies one literal or RE2 regex replacement to a Markdown file.
Compares remote versions or compares a remote file with a local draft.
limitations: It does not import Markdown as an online docx document.
It does not manage file search, movement, deletion, comments, or permissions.
Patch operations are not server-side atomic updates.
It requires lark-cli, authentication, and access to the target Drive resources.

use_cases.title: Publish Team Notes
use_cases.description: Create a native Markdown file in a shared Lark Drive folder from local meeting notes.

use_cases.title: Update Documentation Text
use_cases.description: Patch one phrase or version string across a remote Markdown file without manual download steps.

use_cases.title: Review Draft Differences
use_cases.description: Compare a local Markdown draft with the current remote Drive version before overwriting it.

prompt_templates.title: Fetch a File
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch the Lark Markdown file with this file token and show me the content before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Drive Markdown File
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a native Markdown file in this Lark Drive folder using my local README.md file.

prompt_templates.title: Patch a Specific Phrase
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace this exact phrase in the remote Markdown file, then report whether a new version was uploaded.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Before Overwrite
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my local draft with the latest remote Markdown file, summarize the changes, then ask before overwriting.

output_examples.input: Fetch a remote Markdown file from Lark Drive.
output_examples.output: The assistant returns the Markdown content, file name, size, and the identity used for access.

output_examples.input: Patch one heading in a remote Markdown file.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports whether text matched, whether a new version was uploaded, and the resulting version number.

output_examples.input: Compare a local draft with a remote Markdown version.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes added and removed sections and highlights whether the files differ.

best_practices: Confirm the target folder, Wiki node, or file token before running a write operation.
Use dry run or diff workflows before overwriting important Markdown files.
Escape regex patterns carefully when using patch mode with special characters.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to import Markdown as a Lark online docx document.
Do not guess token types by trying Drive, Wiki, or document URLs randomly.
Do not run regex patch commands without checking the exact match scope first.

faq.question: What type of files does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages native Markdown files stored as regular files in Lark or Feishu Drive.

faq.question: Can it import Markdown as an online Lark document?
faq.answer: No. Use the Lark Drive import workflow for docx-style online documents.

faq.question: Can it save remote Markdown content locally?
faq.answer: Yes. The fetch workflow can return content directly or save it to a local output path.

faq.question: Does patch mode update only part of the remote file?
faq.answer: It performs one replacement locally, then uploads the full updated Markdown file.

faq.question: Can it compare two versions of a remote Markdown file?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare two remote versions or compare a remote version with a local draft.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: The active Lark identity needs permission to read, create, or update the target Drive resource.
